title: PMT and PPMT joint pilots: 7 of 28 and 536 of 640, both group totals
status_plain: Two older joint samples over the annuity family, both group totals and neither splittable per surface. The W088 pilot ran 28 PMT and PPMT cases with 7 exact matches, 21 numeric bit mismatches and nothing blocked. The expanded finance sample ran 640 Excel-sampled cases with 536 exact matches, 102 deviations classed as expected, and 2 adjacent high-rate long-horizon PPMT rows where OxFunc returned #NUM! while Excel returned a tiny value or zero. Neither may be distributed to PMT or to PPMT. The 640-case sample is also not a like-for-like comparison with the exactness corpora: 102 of its deviations are pre-classified as expected, so its 536 is not the same predicate as an exact-bits pass count. The one per-surface datum here is a single PPMT witness at 1 ULP.
